primary_local_effect: pooled frozen confirmation folds 2 and 3; screen and all-four-fold effects reported separately
historical_confirmation_exposure: folds 2 and 3 previously inspected; not untouched
sensitivity_coordinate_scope: illustrative conditional assumptions, not mandatory mean deductions or empirically identified novel-family bounds
scenario_selection_rule: retain both; do not choose by lower calibration RMSE

selection_replay.scope: local plug-in diagnostic; observed effect vector approximates population effects; does not reconstruct historical upstream search

prohibited_forecast_shortcuts: historical absolute-score slope used as validated clean-gain transfer
local bootstrap interval labeled public predictive interval
RMSE divided by sqrt(11) used as public mean uncertainty
1.96 times RMSE labeled a calibrated 95 predictive interval
empirical residual range labeled a 95 predictive interval
summing correlated family gains without evaluating complete frozen predictions
in-sample final development predictions used as OOF bridge
setting unidentified selection or transport terms to favorable values by assertion
future_forecast_requirement: numeric mean traced to declared family-specific scientific assumptions and matched empirical evidence, independent audit and credible alternative-model sensitivity; interval calibration claims require additional assumptions
gate_at_freeze: unsupported; continue research to improve evidence
